reviews.comment: Class was a cake walk. I had to miss a lot and it was still very very easy. If everyday logic comes easy to you this class will be perfectly fine.

Not a horrible professor, but I still wouldn't take this class with him again. I had many points throughout the semester where I thought I would fail. He goes through the material really fast, and it is hard to keep up, but the TAs saved me. I'm not good at math, though. I would say just go to the study sessions and reviews, you'll be fine.

Professor Menzel derailed from the topic occasionally so it was easy to zone out but gave a lot of hints about the exams if you came to class. I personally attended every SI session which is what truly saved my grade. Gives mini exams at the end of the semester incase you didn't do to good on the first 2! Textbook was available but not mandatory.

TA's make or break this class. Lectures are sort of helpful but it was very common for people to not go and just go to the TA's labs and SI sessions. The only grades are quizzes and exams but the quizzes are pretty easy and you should get 100's on all of them as long as you show up. The exams however... Fortunately A LOT of partial credit is given.

Dr. Menzel is a passionate, knowledgeable professor. The Web Tutor is a great tool; use it. The labs are easy since the TAs will help you get 100s on all the quizzes. If you have the time, I recommend studying the material on your own, too. Overall, the class isn't too hard if you keep up with the content and practice using the Web Tutor.
Dont do it

Dr. Menzel deeply cares about his students. The material, point blank, is difficult at first, no matter who you take it with. Dr. Menzel works his hardest to make sure you both digest and enjoy the material. 10/10 recommend!

I went to class, took average at best notes, and started studying for the three exams two days before and I am currently sitting at an A plus. People make this class harder than it is. If you can get lewis roth. as your TA he is amazing and so sweet. Use the webtutor, you don't need the textbook. Take this if you are bad at math for credit.

This is not an easy class to begin with, and it will ALL DEPEND ON WHO YOUR TA IS. Get into a section with Lewis R, 100%. Menzel is a good prof, but not great at explaining concepts in-depth... you need to be able to teach yourself with the WebTutor, or have a good TA to depend on. It is fs possible to get a good grade, but you have to work for it.

Dr. Menzel is a good and very knowledgeable professor. He has a tendency to ramble, but other than that, he is helpful when answering questions and teaches logic in an uncomplicated way. If you do the web tutor a little bit every day for this class and pay attention, it is honestly not very hard. Exams are exactly what he says they will be.

PHIL240 is a hard class for sure, regarding the concepts of logic overall. Menzel is a sweet guy, and he is willing to work with you if you email him. I failed a couple exams BAD and still made a passing grade. If you have a good TA they will help you so much and you can get 100s on all of ur weekly quizzes. Not a horrible option for math credits

This is the type of class that you actually need to study a little bit every week to completely grasp the concepts but once you get it, it's pretty easy. He does not advertise extra credit but you can tell he gives huge curves on exams, specially the final. ASK YOUR TA FOR HELP!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is honestly great if you take the time to familiarize yourself with the content. Do the WebTutor problems as you learn the material in class, or you'll find yourself very overwhelmed when it comes time to study for the exam. Tons of extra credit on exams and your TA can be a huge resource. WebTutor is the key to doing well in this class!

Okay so the only reason I passed this class is because I went to office hours provided by my TA(thank you Lewis Rosenberg). So if your TA has office hours...GO! There's usually not a lot of people and you can get one on one help and practice. Professor Menzel is okay. You wont fully learn the topic tho by just attending his lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Whatever you do, just don't Q-Drop! He knows his class is hard, and has his TA's grade accordingly. Curves and partial/extra credit GALORE on exams. Had a 78 when finals came around, took it and probably made a 50 in reality, but I'm actively staring at a 99 in canvas and a B average! Even if you don't get it, you're rewarded for not quitting/Q-ing

Prof Menzel is a decent lecturer on a difficult subject. He doesn't grade by much (25% of the grade is quizzes, the other 75% is on tests), so do problems on the Web Tutor to do well in the class. It's a great course if you stay on top of things, just DO NOT make the mistake of thinking you can study the day before exams and you will be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sometimes he goes on tangents but overall explains the topics throughly. If you are not a good test taker, this is not the class for you. Tests make up majority of the grade and are relatively hard. If you have time to meet with your TA you will do fine!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The concepts were made even more difficult to understand without guidance on solving actual problems. TAs were extremely helpful, and the professor was accessible on Slack for quick questions, but outside of that, you are on your own to figure it out. Find a different professor or prepare to spend your entire semester sobbing, lost, and confused.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Menzel is not a terrible person, but a lacking professor. His lectures are strictly his speaking, and he leaves little to no room for questions. He also does not provide any room for growth outside of labs and exams. If you take this class and aren't good at math, prepare to struggle. If you get a TA, hope for Rosenburg. Good luck if not.

This is by far the worst class you will take at TAMU. If you hate math, YOU WILL HATE THIS CLASS MORE. The professor lectures super long and are very boring. Get prepared to learn it yourself and go to office hours. He heavily relies on a web tutor that is not helpful. I drove to class without a seatbelt everyday because I dreaded this class.

Professor Mendel is a very good professor. On the other hand, the class PHIL240 is very difficult. Your only grades are the weekly quizzes (25% of your grade) and the 2 exams + the final (75% of your grade). The exams are only like 4 questions but you get points by just trying. If you really apply yourself and use the "Web Tutor" you'll be good
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Menzel is kind and knowledgeable, but fails to teach in easy-to-understand terms. Be prepared to practice and apply the material in order to learn it; simply attending lectures and labs is insufficient. Tests had very few questions, though partial credit was sometimes given. Grade was comprised of in-lab quizzes (25%) and three exams (75%).
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Menzel is not terrible he just has the tendency to ramble sometimes and some of his examples are kinda convoluted. He also HEAVILY depends on an online logic web tutor for help. If you have a good TA you may be better off. If you're willing to spend lots of time frustrated by hypothetical letters that mean nothing then this is the class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class to fulfill my math credit w/o having to take math 140. It's a difficult class but I would still choose this over a regular math class. This class requires a lot of studying on your time, specifically through a web tutor. If you work problems out enough on the web tutor it will eventually get easier. Menzel is helpful will work w u

Class duration was short and he got off topic a lot so you kind of have to take a lot of time to yourself to teach yourself the materials. The concept of this "logic" class is not logical at all and I do not get how this subject in general is valuable to life in any way. The tests are short and hard but he is really helpful.
I literally had to teach this course to myself. Don't take this course unless you're willing to teach yourself.

The class itself is extremely difficult if you are already bad at math. It was terrible and I would diligently work on the web tutor and I still would not understand half of the content. Logic makes no sense at all. The professor is super easy to access which was a plus but during lectures he will get off topic and talk about irrelevant nonsense.

This is a tough course, but if you do the web tutor and practice proofs and other problems often, getting good grades is very achievable! Professor Menzel allows us to retake our original 2 exams and average them with the retakes, which can really help your grade. He cares a lot about what he teaches and helping students!

He was a silly goofy guy and super accessible. But, his class was so hard for me. If you are not a math person I would not recommend this class. I had more mental breakdowns because of this class than any other. It was hard, fast-paced, and super complex. He has an issue of going off on tangents. Don't take this if you value your happiness.

He's a funny guy, but I found his lectures completely useless and there's a textbook that we've never used, so I wouldn't buy it. If I were reviewing the TAs, they'd get a great score because they're doing 90% of the actual teaching in the Labs, which you should go to for an easy 100 and to actually learn something. Grind labs, SIs, and Web Tutor.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Menzel is a sweet guy who really enjoys the subject he teaches. However, his lectures are very confusing and this subject makes no sense. I was told this was a great math credit for someone who hates math, do not believe anyone who tells you that!! I've heard some catch on quickly, but everyone I have personally talked to does not.

Professor Menzel was always available to help thorughout the year through slack and office hours. The TAs were also extremely helpful. The biggest asset this class has to offer is supplemental Instruction. If you want to succeed, which is honestly quite easy if you put in a bit of time, simply go to SI and practice on the Web Tutor.

Love Dr. Menzel! Really fun guy, he said "chonky" a few times in class. Attendance not required but you should really go to make sure you know the material. Weekly quizzes (easy) and 3 exams, all have 10 pts ex cred and you can make up your grade on the final. You have to work pretty hard to get a B. Prof always available on Slack. Would recommend!

Difficult class but help is available. Grade is 25% labs and 75% exams. Your lowest lab is dropped and you have a chance to improve your test scores by taking an extra quiz during the final. I did not really use the textbook (it costs money), I just used class materials and a free homework platform.

Logic is tough because it's a very unfamiliar subject for many people, but I personally enjoyed it a lot. Dr. Menzel is nice and has a good sense of humor in his lectures, although I personally found the online resources to be the most helpful tools. The labs are a good way to boost your grade if you attend consistently and ask for help when needed

Professor Menzel is an amazing professor, however the structure of the class makes this course a bit difficult. The only grades are weekly quizzes and exams, so it's easy to fail. Attendance was mandatory, but he never took attendance. Missing class only harms you though, the class material is difficult to teach to yourself.

Menzel is a great prof and is passionate about logic. Treats the class as a grad class and is willing to help anyone with questions. There were only 2 grades in the class (tests) and they were take-home. He uses Slack and he is extremely easy to talk to and responds quickly. Lectures go off topic pretty easily and content is difficult but good clas
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice guy. He is well beyond intro, so is hard to understand in lectures sometime. Class is a difficult concept. Some get it, some dont. If you work on the web tutor you will be fine, but don't take this class unless you are deciplined enough to learn some concepts completely unrelated to math and work hard for your credit. NOT easier than math
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Menzel is very knowledgeable in logic. Anyone who takes the course knows that he lives and breathes it. There is a quiz every week and 3 tests. There is no graded homework, but you may practice with him or the SI at any time on Slack. I would recommend going to the SI at least once a week if you need extra clarity. Easy enough for a math.

Dr. Menzel is nice and funny, and the class is unique but useful (definitely take it if you ever plan on taking the LSAT). The web tutor is incredibly helpful; I basically taught myself everything using this rather than going to class. The tests aren't difficult if you know what you're doing, but if you don't... good luck

Honestly you can skip lecture and pass as long as you go to SI and every Lab meeting. Lectures were pointless. This class was SO hard, but for tests he makes it so you start with 30 points just for turning it in, so you CAN pass if you put the work in. Use the WebTutor (practice probs), go to every SI, and be your TA's best friend.
I loved Dr. Menzel! He was so helpful and genuinely cares about his students. Tbh if you put in the work and effort you will do really well in the class. 10/10 Prof, TAs, and SI!

I honestly had no choice but to take Menzel because he's the only professor for PHIL 240. He doesn't really teach, he essentially just talks to himself during lectures. I can honestly say i'm so glad I took this class during the pandemic because there is no way i would've came out with a passing grade. I chose the pass/fail option for this class.

Dr. Menzel was okay. His class isn't mandatory attendance, so most of us didn't go to class because his lectures often made things more confusing. I loved PHIL240, but mostly because of the T.A.'s and the SI instructor. Easy A, but not that great of a professor.

His lectures were essentially just him reading his notes over, so not great, but he's nice and was willing to answer any questions students had. The TA's were much more helpful to me, but at least Menzel was chill. He offers extra credit on every exam, the final wasn't cumulative, and he really seems to care about his students.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not a bad prof, but dont bother showing up to class, just go to all SI sessions and labs, practice the web tutor and youll be fine. No book needed even tho they tell you to buy it. the course is kinda weird, no math in it. take another math class if you can, but if youre responsible and like to learn on your own youll be fine. test graded heavily.

JUST TAKE A MATH CLASS. I took a math class at TAMU and made an A, and I'm worried I'll make a C in this class. It's not something easily understood, even if you're great at math-there's literally NO MATH IN THIS CLASS. You don't need a textbook or to attend lecture, but GO TO LAB and even SI if you can.

This class can be difficult because the material is kind of weird and not something most people have learned before; it makes your brain think in a different way. No need to buy the textbook, just use the web tutor frequently. A good grade can be achieved if you practice enough. Extra credit sometimes given if no one shows up to class
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests count for 75% of grade and the rest is quiz grades. Tests are graded pretty harshly with little to no partial credit. Not a terrible prof, but went off on tangents unrelated to the material, so you may feel like you are wasting your time attending class. Not necessary to attend lecture, but GO TO LABS. Lab quizzes are easy A's.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: *IF YOU'RE ACADEMIC ADVISOR TOLD YOU THIS WAS AN EASY MATH CREDIT THIS REVIEW IS FOR YOU* Some people find it easy but it is just such a WEIRD subject. This professor teaches this class as if you already know the material. I learned everything from SI instruction which I had to go to 3 TIMES A WEEK to barely understand what is going on.

He is kinda all over the place and gets on tangents, but if you pay attention to the important stuff it is very helpful. Most important thing is going to labs and working with the TAs. Class material gets more difficult as the course goes on so practice on the web tutor! No need to buy a book he provides what you need on his website.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The exams aren't hard if you do the work and seek out help! He goes over everything you need to know in class so you shouldn't be blindsided. So glad I took this and not Calculus.

Lectures are important. A lot of people would skip class but I don't understand how because the material talked about is very in-depth and detailed. The TA's are your best friends, the labs are the most important part of the class. Based off 2 tests and easy quizzes every week. I'm not a math person at all but I made an A+ in this class.

The material itself for this class is not hard as long as you go to the SI sessions or tutoring. Going to the lectures was not much help. You have a lab where you have quizzes every week that helps with your grade because they average out to a whole test grade. If you don't like math, I would take this class.
The TAs will be the only reason you survive.

Overall a completely doable class. You have to actually work for it though. Don't expect it to come to you right away. You have to practice on the web tutor and go to the SI sessions to do well. This is coming from someone who is very bad at math most of the time. He gives you all the opportunity to do well so don't be scared.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: JUST TAKE CALC!!!! This class is much harder than any intro math class, and more difficult than academic advisors make it out to be. The tests are only 3-4 questions with minimal partial credit, making it incredibly hard to earn a grade that is indicative of your actual knowledge. Menzel tends to ramble during his lectures and doesn't really teach.

Doesn't care about his students. Never prepared for class. If you are bold enough to ask a question/clarification on his confusing lessons, he treats you as if you were stupid. Instead of being encouraging, he will roll his eyes and respond with a sassy "come on, you should know this." Skips half the lesson bc "it's easy stuff" for HIM. Apathetic.

The tests were always much harder than the weekly assignments and quizzes. I also did not like that the majority of his lectures were spent talking about how difficult the subject was and then we always ran out of time to work problems. The TAs were the best but this class still was still very frustrating.
I'm on the fence about this class. I made an A, and never went to class other than the labs. There are 4 grades in the entire course. Very stressful.

Dr. Menzel was an okay professor. He doesn't really teach... kinda just rambles on about nothing and goes off of his notes that aren't very helpful. ONLY reason I passed this class is because of my great TA. If you're great at math, you will do fine. If math isn't your best like me, you might struggle a little bit.

It was a great class to be in! Make sure you go to every class to understand the concepts. The tests were not difficult, you just must work on the logic tutor almost after every class. The SI really helped and the TAs. Tests material was told ahead of time and what you need to know was clearly stated. Web tutor is the most essential part to passing

He's a super smart guy, and the class is easy if you go to the lectures, labs, and do practice like SI and online problems. He gives extra credit for attendance and will offer extra credit problems. I honestly talked to my TA a lot more than I did Menzel, but it's an easy A or B as long as you study.

I learned everything by going to the Supplementary Instruction (SI) Tutoring provided for this class. The lectures were not helpful and but extra credit was often given for attending. The lab is very helpful to understanding and practicing the concepts.  Concepts are hard to grasp at first, but ended up being fun. I hate math, but loved this class.

Lectures are long and not helpful, but Menzel will give extra credit for those who go. 3 tests including the final. No homework or quizzes, just 1 lab a week. Do not buy the textbook, just print off the notes on his website. I am NOT a math person by any means but was able to get an A by going to 4.0 and go.

The class was harder than i expected, there are multiple ways to make an A but it is really really time consuming. Took it as a math substitute and it wasnt awful but not great either. If your gonna take logic take him and GO TO CLASS! HE GIVES EXTRA CREDIT

Took class as a sub for math, wish I would have just taken math. Lots of outside practice is required to make the grade you want but the TAs and SI are pretty helpful. Lectures are long, boring and make you want to sleep but he gives extra credit for showing up, so go as much as you can stand to.

My favorite professor in college so far, by far. He stayed up the night before our final helping people out on the course facebook page until almost 2:00 am! He is really dedicated to helping his students understand the material and gives more than one opportunity to fix a not so fantastic grade. If you want to take this class, he is your guy.

The content is difficult if you are not a math person. I was, so I got a near 100 for the class. For my peers it was a struggle because it turned words into equations. Weekly labs were just freebie 100s, counts as "4th exam". I grew to love doing the work, weirdly. If you practice, it becomes 2+2.  Never got the book.
Dr. Menzel is probably one of the coolest professors I've taken. His laid back attitude makes the course enjoyable and even though it was my least favorite class , he was still my favorite prof.

I would not buy a book for this class. Print off his notes from the logic website and GO TO CLASS! He even gives surprise extra credit for students who come to class. As long as you take the notes and use the webtutor regularly, this class should fairly easy. He is funny and nice, and tries to make a math class interesting.

This class was very difficult for me to understand, but Professor Menzel does a wonderful job at offering you all the help you need and gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. Make sure you go to lab every week & practice on the web tutor.
Very clear, very good teacher. Depends really on your TA whoever you get. This class can be really tough or really easy depending on how often you attend class. DO THE WEB TUTOR, IT HELPS BIG TIME!!!
